subject: dtcc-tokenization
note: Zero public instrumentation weeks before launch
honest_sentence: DTCC is commercially launching tokenised Russell 1000 equities, SPY/QQQ ETFs, and US Treasuries on Canton and Besu in October 2026, with Stellar integration planned for H1 2027 — a 50-member working group driving the single biggest pending RWA measurement event, yet no public instrumentation has been disclosed weeks before go-live.
